stories.body:
Six years following Stripe's historic acquisition, Nigerian fintech leader Paystack is undergoing a strategic shift. According to reports from TechCabal published in October 2026, the company is altering its core business model.

Rather than solely focusing on moving money across digital channels, Paystack is now learning how to keep deposits. This pivot represents a major evolution for the platform.
